hook: Every campaign that works has 4 parts. Most that fail are missing #3.
direction: Offer, audience, message, follow-up. #3 — message-audience fit — is the usual failure: the right cause pitched in the wrong words. Framework graphic, save-worthy.

facebook.text:
Every campaign that works has 4 parts. Most that fail are missing #3.

Here they are:
1) Offer — what you're asking people to do
2) Audience — who you're asking
3) Message-audience fit — the right cause in the right words for that specific person
4) Follow-up — what happens after they respond

Number 3 is where most campaigns quietly die. The cause is good. The offer is real. But the words land wrong because they were written for the wrong person. Save this and check your next campaign against it.

2) Audience

Number 3 is the quiet killer. The cause is worthy. The offer is solid. But the words were written for the wrong person — or the right person in the wrong language.

Save this. Run your next campaign through it before you launch.
